description: The Ancient Forge is an interactive structure found once each in the Abandoned Temple, Gardens, and Sanctuary (3 per expedition). It lets players choose between upgrading a weapon or an ability, up to 3 Forge Upgrades per weapon/ability. Requires the Ancient Forge skill on the Soul Wheel.

weaponUpgrades.note: Each of the 8 weapons has 8 unique Forge Upgrades of its own (no upgrades are shared across weapons). See data/weapons.json -> weapons[].forgeUpgrades.

abilityUpgrades.note: Each ability has 11 upgrades unique to it, plus these 5 upgrades shared across every ability. Per-ability unique upgrades are not yet extracted (see Abilities page).

shared.description: Decreases cooldown by 10% for every Ability stack.

shared.description: Increases Ability damage by 10% for each God Blessing on your Ability.
